preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND column_name = 'precompute_script' AND table_name IN ('practice', 'practice_revision', 'curated_practice_override')

changeSet.comment: Rename the script column of practices, practice revisions and curated practice overrides to practice_script. The projection check reads the column by name at run time, so it is replaced in the same transaction. The trigger column list and the override shape check follow the rename by themselves. No row changes.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE practice RENAME COLUMN precompute_script TO practice_script; ALTER TABLE practice_revision RENAME COLUMN precompute_script TO practice_script; ALTER TABLE curated_practice_override RENAME COLUMN precompute_script TO practice_script;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_practice_current_revision_projection() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM practice practice JOIN practice_revision revision ON revision.id = practice.current_revision_id AND revision.practice_id = practice.id LEFT JOIN practice_group practice_group ON practice_group.id = practice.practice_group_id WHERE practice.id = NEW.id AND revision.slug = practice.slug AND revision.name = practice.name AND revision.applies_to = practice.applies_to AND revision.signals = practice.signals AND revision.evidence_requirements = practice.evidence_requirements AND revision.review_when = practice.review_when AND revision.subject = practice.subject AND revision.precondition IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.precondition AND revision.criteria = practice.criteria AND revision.practice_script IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.practice_script AND revision.automated_review_policy = practice.automated_review_policy AND revision.delivery_behavior = practice.delivery_behavior AND revision.why_it_matters IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.why_it_matters AND revision.what_good_looks_like IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.what_good_looks_like AND revision.group_slug IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice_group.slug ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'practice current revision does not match its current projection' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF; RETURN NULL; END; $$;
